artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative title page. The title page features an intricate floral border design with interconnected floral garlands and ribbons. The text includes "Varj Capriccj," credits to "Gio. Battista Tiepolo," and dedication to "S. Girolamo Manfrin."

artworks.title: Youth, Sage, and Attendant with Horse
artworks.description: Three figures and a horse are depicted in this image. Two men are central, with one riding the horse in front of the other man, who is on foot. The rider wears a cloak and has curly hair, a strong nose, and a pronounced chin. The second man wears similar clothing, a full beard, and a head covering partially obscured by the horse's mane. The third man is crouched by the horse's shoulder, with short hair, a tunic, and boots. A staff or spear and a glove lie on the ground in the foreground. In the background, a barren branch extends from the right with an owl perched on it. The background is minimally detailed with a faint suggestion of landscape in the distance.

artworks.title: Seated Youth Leaning Against an Urn
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures around a large ornate urn. The scene shows figures in various relaxed poses, with some leaning against the urn, which is decorated with a sculptural face. The background includes architectural elements like columns or pillars, and a fragment resembling a building or wall. The figures wear attire that suggests historical or theatrical costumes, adding to a sense of drama. The line work shows attention to detail in rendering texture and depth on both human forms and objects. The use of shadows and cross-hatching adds three-dimensionality to the drawing. A landscape with hints of vegetation and a distant horizon is visible behind the figures.

artworks.title: Three Soldiers and a Youth
artworks.description: This print shows an outdoor scene with three soldiers and a fourth person lying on their stomach. The soldiers are equipped with armor and long weapons, and two of them are talking to each other, their faces obscured, while the third looks directly at us. Another person lies on the ground on the right, wearing casual clothing and observing the soldiers. The setting is an open land with distant hills, and thin lines hint at trees. It is signed "Tiepolo" on the left. It is monochromatic, with dark lines on brown paper.

artworks.title: Soldier Seated on a Tomb with Surrounding Figures
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene set in ancient times. The composition features figures in dramatic poses, with one central figure seated on a stone bench while others gather around, potentially conversing or witnessing an event. To the right, there is a structure or ruin with a weathered column or large stone. The scene is detailed, showing folds in drapery, textures of stone, and intricate hairstyles of the figures. The line work by the artist is expressive and dynamic, conveying movement and emotion.

artworks.title: Standing Woman and Seated Men before an Obelisk
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman holding a large urn. She stands next to a pedestal with two other figures nearby. One figure is seated in a classical pose, while the other wears period attire with a distinctive helmet. The background features a natural setting with skies and water. The drawing style includes precise lines and detailed cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Woman, Satyr Child, and Goat in a Landscape
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with animals and nature. The drawing features a lounging figure, an animal, and a landscape. To the left, a goat with horns is standing and stretching its left leg. In the center, a figure is resting under a tree, with fabric draped around. Surrounding the figures, foliage and trees add depth to the scene. The background shows an expansive landscape with fields, plains, and distant mountains. The line work and stylized forms suggest movement and harmony. The drawing captures pastoral serenity and is detailed and artistic.

artworks.title: Standing Philosopher and Two Other Figures
artworks.description: This print depicts three people near a body of water. The two on the left are crouched over and appear to be speaking. One has their back to us, and the other person’s face is only partially visible. The crouching people both wear long, flowing robes with hoods. They are on the ground near a long pole that may be a flag or sail. The person on the right is standing upright with one arm resting on a stone ledge or platform. They have visible facial features including a beard and a furrowed brow. This person's hair is long and covered with a head scarf. Around them are elements of a rural or riverside setting; there is a decorative urn on the ground in the right-hand corner and leafy trees in the background. The background on the left includes simple lines depicting a cloudy sky over calm water.

artworks.title: Women and Men Regarding a Burning Pyre of Bones
artworks.description: This is a print of a group of people looking at a pile of objects in an outdoor setting. The five people are all gathered together in the center of the print, looking to the right, four of them crouching on a tall ledge and the other person kneeling by a large stone. They are all looking towards a pile of objects in the lower right corner that appears to include several bones and the skull of an animal, as well as other unidentifiable shapes. On the left are several vases and a pile of cloth or fabric at the base of a tall column. There are several tall trees in the background on the right, and the sky above is mostly empty except for a few feathery lines that suggest clouds.

artworks.title: Death Giving Audience
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a group gathering around a skeletal figure. The drawing depicts a group of individuals draped in cloaks and headwear, closely peering over a rectangular frame that hangs with a ring. On the ground, a skeletal figure sits, draped in tattered clothing, clutching scrolls. There is a dog near the frame and rustic wooden elements in the background. The style of the drawing features intricate linework and attention to detail, creating a sense of movement and tension in the scene.

artworks.title: Young Soldier with Philosopher and Seated Woman
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a group of figures around a circular object with a face in relief. The scene is detailed in black and white, with several figures engaged in a narrative. One figure is reaching toward an oval object with a Gorgon's face. A seated figure to the left seems to be reacting to the central action. A tree with detailed foliage is depicted above. Intensity is conveyed through shadow work and cross-hatching. A snake-like shape links to a chain at the bottom, adding complexity. The composition's detail and style suggest an artist skilled in evoking motion and drama through precise linework.

artworks.title: Soldier with Horse and Attendant
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene featuring a horse, a dog, and two figures. In the illustration, there is a large horse on the right side, with its head slightly turned to the left. The horse's mane is detailed with fine lines. In front of the horse, a small dog is sniffing the ground. To the left, two figures are behind the horse. The figure closest holds the reins, while the second figure carries a staff-like object. The background consists of minimal lines indicating a horizon or distant landscape. The overall use of line work includes crosshatching and contour lines to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Arms of Karl Philip von Greiffenklau, Prince-Bishop of Wurzburg
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring various symbolic elements. The scene includes mythical and allegorical figures in the sky above an architectural depiction of a castle. The main figures consist of an angelic figure with wings, holding a cross and a trumpet, accompanied by others holding shields and a crosier. Below them is a detailed illustration of a grand building with domed towers, surrounded by trees, and fortified walls. The composition is executed in fine lines typical of etching.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: This is a drawing of calligraphic text. The image features finely executed handwritten words in a classic and ornate calligraphy style, with various sizes and flourishes in the letters. The lines are neat and the text is centered on the paper. The script includes titles and names in Italian, such as "La Fugga in Egitto Giesu, Maria e Giuseppe" and "Domenico Tiepolo." The paper shows signs of aging with subtle sepia tones and an elegantly understated background.

artworks.title: Joseph Relays to Mary God's Command to Flee
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a child in the center. The woman is seated and holding the child on her lap. The child is sitting upright. Another baby is in a crib nearby. An elderly man is standing to the right, gesturing with one hand and holding a staff with the other. The background depicts a room with stone walls, heavy drapes, and a window on the right side.

artworks.title: Joseph and Mary Prepare to Leave
artworks.description: This is an artwork of a scene set in a rustic, covered setting with a thatched roof. The image shows a family and a donkey in a stable or similar structure. The style resembles Rembrandt's. The composition is dense with detailed lines, creating a textured appearance in the clothing and background elements. In the center, an individual holds a bundle, another figure with a staff and halo stands beside them. The donkey, standing near a wooden door, appears heavily burdened, with another figure assisting. A winged character on the far right suggests an ethereal or divine presence. Vegetation surrounds the area, enhancing the rustic and natural setting depicted.

artworks.title: Joseph Kneels with the Child before Mary on the Donkey
artworks.description: This print shows a group of people gathered under a tall tree with a wide canopy. Slightly to the left of center, a woman is seated on a donkey. She wears a billowing white dress with a white cloth covering her hair, and there is a large halo around her head. She is looking down and to the right, where a man kneels on the ground next to her, looking up at her. The man also wears billowing robes and has a beard and a mustache. In his arms he cradles a young child. Several people with large wings surround the group, with one on the left behind the donkey's head, and one on the right holding a cloth up behind the kneeling man. On the far right, near the bottom right corner, a person sits at the base of the large tree, looking to the left towards the group. This person wears a puffy hat or bonnet, a long dress, and a thick dark cloak on their shoulders. They sit next to a large basket containing round objects. Next to this person is a dog that also looks left. Behind this person is a tall stone wall, and on the left the background opens up to a clear sky. The ground is covered with dark, crosshatching lines.

artworks.title: The Holy Family Passes under a City Arch
artworks.description: This is a print of a group passing under an archway. The scene features a cloaked person on a donkey led by another individual with a staff, walking towards an opening showing a landscape with hills and clouds. They are on the left and have their backs to us. On the right, looking around the corner of a large wall, a group of other people stand observing the travelers. The wall and arch are detailed with brick patterns and foliage draping from the arch’s top edge. The contrast of light and shadow adds depth to the scene.

artworks.title: The Flight with the Holy Family at the Right
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene featuring figures and a herd of sheep. A group of figures is depicted on the left-hand side, with some of them reclining on fluffy, cloud-like structures. To the right, the drawing features a herd of sheep being tended to by a figure, who is partially obscured by the tree; nearby, another scene shows a person riding a donkey while another walks beside the animal, using a staff for support. The landscape is characterized by gentle undulations and distant architectural structures, evoking a sense of tranquility, with fine detailing enhancing the textures of fur, fabric, foliage, and clouds.

artworks.title: Joseph, Standing, Adores the Child
artworks.description: The image depicts full-body figures in an illustration. In the center, there is a person seated on a donkey, clad in flowing garments, holding a child. To the left, another figure is leading the donkey. The child's eyes are closed. Surrounding the central figures are several figures with wings, possibly angels. The clothing details are intricate, with minimal jewelry. The background shows a town below a sky with clouds, and tall trees on the left. In the sky, more winged figures are visible.

artworks.title: The Flight with the Holy Family at the Left
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with three figures and a donkey facing away from the viewer. In the background, there is a low horizon with a sky, birds, clouds, and trees on the right. The artwork is created using a detailed pen or engraving style, emphasizing textures and contrasts. The overall color scheme is monochrome, highlighting the whites of garments and dark lines defining shapes and shadows. Buildings and architectural elements are faintly visible in the distance.

artworks.title: The Flight, Holy Family at the Right, Joseph Looking to the Left
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with figures and animals moving across a natural setting. A draped figure, an animal, and another figure with a basket are on the right side, while a partially visible figure peers out from behind a tree on the left. Two goats stand on a rise, and birds fly in the cloudy sky. The etching technique uses fine lines to create detail, and the monochromatic color scheme gives a classic look.

artworks.title: The Flight, Holy Family Walking with Angel
The Rest on the Flight, with Adoring Angels
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing figures gathered under a palm tree. One figure is seated holding a child, while others and a donkey surround them. Several winged figures are present to the side. The drawing features detailed line work depicting the angels' wings, foliage, and clothing textures. The composition balances the earthly elements of the tree with the divine aspect of the angels.
